decision: No automatic density production. Existing population statistical territories have not been explicitly equated to measured map-polygon extents. Same entity/year alone is insufficient. Preserve compatible-join opportunity for evidence-backed scope reconciliation; no browser or bespoke research.
existingOfficialPairCaution: The 12 official table pairs use source square-mile area and can involve historical population exclusions. They are not map-polygon density, and are not silently promoted under the mapped-density join.
